observed_features: Very long low single-storey cream/yellow station building covered by continuous bright red corrugated hipped roof
Deep platform veranda beneath low broad eave; evenly spaced golden-yellow square columns
Dark rectangular door/window bays behind veranda; no tall central clock tower or grand portico in visible platform elevation
Mature spreading tree grows directly in front of veranda; row of tall slender trees behind roof
Red weathered platform fascia and white platform coping; light-grey smooth veranda floor
uncertainties: Public veranda visible; room subdivision remains unresolved
Some roof sections may change with maintenance
